title: 5 Benefits Of UV Air Sanitizers
desc: To learn more about improving your home's indoor air quality, contact our team at Rosenberg Indoor Comfort today!

blocks.text: In this era, it is evident that air pollution is rampant. This is due to many reasons—ranging from industrialization to the greenhouse effect. It’s, therefore, essential to take a personal air control initiative. This will help you ensure that your surrounding air is clean. Many a time, however, you may debate on the viability of investing in air sanitizers. This may be due to the many expenses that surround our daily lives. But, what if you gauge the pros and cons? You might realize how essential air sanitizers are in improving the quality of your life.
1. Effective in Killing Germs and Viruses

UV air sanitizers are very effective in killing germs and viruses. They utilize the ultraviolet light spectrum to kill airborne germs and viruses. These rays penetrate and damage the DNA or the RNA of the pathogens. They also trigger lethal mutation, a process that prevents them from reproducing. These UV air sanitizers also neutralize some chemicals present in indoor air.

This technology is effective in small, standalone units. Alternatively, it is installed in line with other air conditioning ducts for the sanitation of the whole house air. It’s proven that air sanitization can kill up to 99.99% of germs, leaving you with clean indoor air. The effectiveness, however, may depend on:

items: Whether the germs and viruses meet the UV rays
Whether the cooling effect of airflow inhibits the rays
The type and quality of sanitizer
The length of time the microbial comes in contact with the light

blocks.text: Allergies can cause a lot of discomfort to some individuals. Many a time, these people tend to run away from outdoor activities as a control measure. But sometimes, the allergy triggers are actually indoors moreso than they are outdoors. UV Air Sanitizers are very useful in odor and allergen control. This odor can come from organic and inorganic matters. Some of the volatile organic compounds include carbon chemicals. These chemicals that originate from wall coverings, air fresheners, and flooring can threaten good health.

UV air sanitizers also work by inactivating and killing germs. This does not necessarily reduce the concentration of particulate matter in the air, but it changes how the spores react when they land. The reduction of allergens improves your indoor air quality. This makes it so that children and people with pre-existing conditions such as asthma can live comfortably.

The technology of using ultraviolet rays to clean air has existed for many years. Unlike other sanitizers that use chemicals that are sprayed into the air, these are safe to use. They use the ultraviolet rays to sanitize the air. The science resembles that of the sun as it purifies the outdoor air. These sanitizers zip air through the filters and out the vents to create air circulation in a house. Hospital UV air sanitizers are effective in killing germs by reducing or eliminating airflow.
4. Mitigates the Growth of Microbiological Organisms

Microbial organisms thrive in a humid and warm environment. The continuous use of an HVAC unit can create these environmental conditions, especially air conditioning that creates cool surfaces for condensation to land on. This can create a foothold for a more substantial growth of spores. You can use UV air sanitizers to mitigate these organisms’ growth. The ultra-light system is placed strategically before and after the units. This enhances maximum air exposure as it passes through the light for sanitization. UV air sanitizers work by fighting germs, mildews, and mold as the ultraviolet rays destroy their DNA and hamper their growth. This eliminates their build-up and creates a great environment for improved air.

In your daily endeavors, you are likely to meet germs and viruses. UV air sanitizers have proved to be useful in disinfecting surfaces. You can use them in areas that are likely to come into contact with germs from many people. This includes the home, office, classroom, or daycare. They are also suitable to disinfect phones and small objects like keys and toys. The UV light sanitization eliminates the transfer of germs from one person to another. This is perfect for places that are touched often like doorknobs and handrails.

Owing to the above benefits, it’s evident that UV air sanitizers are very effective and efficient.
